title.zh: 卷389 列傳一百七十六 柏俊 麟魁 瑞常 全庆
title.en: Volume 389 Biographies 176: Bai Jun, Lin Kui, Rui Chang, Quan Qing
title.raw: 卷389 列傳一百七十六 柏俊 麟魁 瑞常 全庆

sentences.zh: 柏葰，原名松葰，字靜濤，巴魯特氏，蒙古正藍旗人。

translations.literal: Bo Yi, whose original name was Song Yi, style name Jingtao, of the Balute clan, was a Mongol of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Bo Yi—originally Song Yi, courtesy name Jingtao—belonged to the Balute clan and came from the Mongol Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 道光六年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Daoguang he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 6 (1826) he became a jinshi, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and received appointment as compiler.

sentences.zh: 累遷內閣學士，兼正紅旗漢軍副都統。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat and concurrently served as vice lieutenant-general of the Plain Red Banner Chinese Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: He rose step by step to Grand Secretariat secretary, while also serving as vice lieutenant-general of the Plain Red Banner Chinese Brigade.

sentences.zh: 十八年，出為盛京工部侍郎，調刑部，兼管奉天府尹。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he went out as vice minister of Works at Mukden, was transferred to Justice, and concurrently supervised the Mukden metropolitan magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 he was posted as Mukden vice minister of Works, moved to Justice, and took charge of the Mukden metropolitan magistrate as well.

sentences.zh: 二十年，召授刑部侍郎，調吏部，又調戶部。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was summoned and appointed vice minister of Justice, transferred to Personnel, and again to Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20 he was recalled to the capital as vice minister of Justice, then shifted to Personnel and afterward to Revenue.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，充諭祭朝鮮正使，例有餽贐，奏卻之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he served as chief envoy on a mission to announce sacrifices in Korea; gifts were customary, but he memorialized to decline them.
translations.idiomatic: In year 23 he headed the Korean condolence mission; though presents were customary, he reported that he refused them.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，充總管內務府大臣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he was appointed superintendent of the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: In year 25 he became superintendent of the Imperial Household Department.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，典江南鄉試。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he presided over the Jiangnan provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: In year 26 he served as chief examiner for the Jiangnan provincial examinations.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「徵漕大戶短欠，取償小戶，劣紳挾制官吏，大戶包攬小戶，畸輕畸重，旗丁需索，加增津貼諸弊，請嚴禁。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "When great households fall short on grain-tax transport, they recover it from small households; base gentry coerce officials; great households take small households under their wing, burdens fall unevenly, banner transport workers demand extras, and surcharges on transit allowances multiply—please forbid these abuses strictly."
translations.idiomatic: In a memorial he wrote: "Large transport households that default shift the loss onto small ones; low-grade gentry bully officials; large households bundle small accounts so levies fall unevenly; banner couriers extort extras and transit subsidies keep rising—these abuses must be stopped."

sentences.zh: 」如議行。

translations.literal: " The memorial was approved and carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The court adopted his proposal.

sentences.zh: 尋偕倉場侍郎陳孚恩盤查山東籓庫，劾布政使王篤濫用幕友及地方官縱盜，巡撫崇恩以下議譴有差。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, together with Granary vice minister Chen Fuen, he audited the Shandong provincial treasury, impeached provincial treasurer Wang Du for abusing private secretaries and local officials for indulging bandits, and the governor Chong En and others were censured to varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: He soon joined Granary vice minister Chen Fuen in auditing Shandong's provincial treasury, impeached treasurer Wang Du for misusing staff and local officials for tolerating bandits, and Chong En the governor and others were reprimanded in due measure.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，擢左都御史。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was promoted to censor-in-chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: In year 28 he was made left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 三十年，遷兵部尚書，授內大臣。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year he was transferred to minister of War and appointed inner court grandee.
translations.idiomatic: In year 30 he became minister of War and an inner-court grandee.

sentences.zh: 尋調吏部，管理三庫，兼翰林院掌院學士。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Personnel, placed in charge of the three treasuries, and concurrently made chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly after he moved to Personnel, took charge of the three treasuries, and also became Hanlin Academy chancellor.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，命偕侍郎善燾赴盛京按協領塔芬布輕聽謠言，調兵護宅，幾至激變，得實，論遣戍。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianfeng he was ordered with vice minister Shan Xi to investigate at Mukden assistant commandant Tafenbu, who had lightly believed rumors, mobilized troops to guard his residence, and nearly provoked a riot; the facts were established and Tafenbu was sentenced to banishment.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 3 he and Vice Minister Shan Xi were sent to Mukden to investigate Assistant Commandant Tafenbu, who had heeded rumors, called out troops to guard his house, and almost sparked a mutiny; the case proved true and he was banished.

sentences.zh: 將軍奕興坐袒護，革任。

translations.literal: General Yi Xing was punished for shielding him and dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: General Yi Xing was punished for covering for him and removed from his post.

sentences.zh: 尋以前在鑲白旗蒙古都統任揀選承襲有誤，罷內務府大臣，降授左副都御史。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, because while Mongol lieutenant-general of the Bordered White Banner he had erred in selecting an heir for an enfeoffment, he was removed as Household superintendent and demoted to left vice censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, an earlier mistake in choosing an heir while Mongol lieutenant-general of the Bordered White Banner cost him the Household post and left him demoted to left vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 未幾，出為馬蘭鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Before long he went out as commandant of Malan Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Not long after he was sent out as commandant of Malan Garrison.

sentences.zh: 五年，擢熱河都統，搜捕山匪。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was promoted to lieutenant-general of Rehe and searched out mountain bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 he was promoted to Rehe lieutenant-general and hunted mountain bandits.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「熱河將惰兵疲，州縣不諳吏治。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "The Rehe garrison is slack and its troops weary; prefectures and districts do not understand governance.
translations.idiomatic: He reported: "Rehe's command is lax and its soldiers worn down; local officials lack sound administration.

sentences.zh: 行使大錢，民皆罷市。

translations.literal: Circulation of large-denomination cash has driven the people to shut their markets.
translations.idiomatic: Issuing large cash coins has driven the people to close their markets.

sentences.zh: 礦匪佔踞山場，委員侵蝕商款。

translations.literal: Mining bandits occupy the hills; commissioners embezzle merchants' funds."
translations.idiomatic: Mining bandits hold the high ground, and commissioners skim merchants' payments."

sentences.zh: 」詔嚴切查辦。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered strict investigation and correction.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered a stern inquiry.

sentences.zh: 召授戶部尚書，兼正黃旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: He was summoned and appointed minister of Revenue, concurrently lieutenant-general of the Plain Yellow Banner Chinese Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled, he became minister of Revenue and lieutenant-general of the Plain Yellow Banner Chinese Brigade.

sentences.zh: 六年，命在軍機大臣上行走，兼翰林院掌院學士。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was ordered to serve on the Grand Council and concurrently remained Hanlin chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 he was placed on the Grand Council while keeping the Hanlin chancellorship.

sentences.zh: 尋以戶部尚書協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Soon, as minister of Revenue, he was made associate grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, as revenue minister, he was made associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 八年，典順天鄉試，拜文淵閣大學士。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he presided over the Shuntian provincial examination and was appointed Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 he ran the Shuntian provincial exams and was appointed Wenyuan Pavilion grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 柏葰素持正，自登樞府，與載垣、端華、肅順等不協。

translations.literal: Bo Yi had always been upright; after entering the Grand Council he did not get along with Zaiyuan, Duanhua, Sushun, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Bo Yi was known for integrity; once he joined the Grand Council he clashed with Zaiyuan, Duanhua, Sushun, and their faction.

sentences.zh: 會御史孟傳金疏劾本科士論未孚，命覆勘試卷，應議者五十卷，文宗震怒，褫柏葰等職，命載垣等會鞫，得柏葰聽信家人靳祥言，取中羅鴻繹情事，靳祥斃於獄。

translations.literal: When censor Meng Chuanjin memorialized that candidates in the current jinshi class were dissatisfied, the emperor ordered the papers re-examined; fifty volumes were found objectionable. Emperor Wenzong was furious, stripped Bo Yi and others of office, and ordered Zaiyuan and others to conduct a joint trial. It was found that Bo Yi had believed his servant Jin Xiang and placed Luo Hongyi among the successful candidates; Jin Xiang died in prison.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Meng Chuanjin charged that the new jinshi class was discontented; the papers were re-checked and fifty were faulted. Emperor Wenzong in rage dismissed Bo Yi and others and had Zaiyuan's group investigate jointly. They proved Bo Yi had heeded his servant Jin Xiang and passed Luo Hongyi; Jin Xiang died in custody.

sentences.zh: 九年，讞上，上猶有矜全之意，為肅順等所持。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the verdict was submitted; the emperor still meant to spare him, but Sushun and others held firm.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 the sentence went up; the emperor still wished to show mercy, but Sushun and his allies prevailed.

sentences.zh: 乃召見王大臣等諭曰：「科場為掄才大典，交通舞弊，定例綦嚴。

translations.literal: He then summoned the princes and grandees and instructed them: "The civil service examinations are the great canon for selecting talent; trafficking in favor and cheating are forbidden by settled law, and the statutes are exceedingly strict.
translations.idiomatic: He summoned the princes and senior ministers and said: "Examinations are the grand rite for choosing talent; bribery and fraud are barred by iron precedent.

sentences.zh: 自來典試諸臣，從無敢以身試法者。

translations.literal: Never before have chief examiners dared test the law with their own persons.
translations.idiomatic: No examiner has ever dared break the law on his own account.

sentences.zh: 不意柏葰以一品大員，辜恩藐法，至於如是！

translations.literal: I did not expect that Bo Yi, a minister of the first rank, would spurn grace and despise the law to this degree!"
translations.idiomatic: Yet Bo Yi, a first-rank minister, has scorned imperial favor and flouted the law so brazenly!"

sentences.zh: 柏葰身任大臣，且系科甲進士出身，豈不知科場定例？

translations.literal: Bo Yi bears high office and is himself a jinshi graduate—how could he not know examination regulations?
translations.idiomatic: Bo Yi holds high rank and is himself a jinshi—how could he not know the rules?

sentences.zh: 竟以家人幹請，輒即撤換試卷。

translations.literal: Yet at a servant's plea he promptly exchanged examination papers.
translations.idiomatic: Still, at a household servant's request, he swapped papers without hesitation.

sentences.zh: 若使靳祥尚在，加以夾訊，何難盡情吐露？

translations.literal: Had Jin Xiang still lived and been put to the rack, what difficulty would there have been in making him confess everything?
translations.idiomatic: If Jin Xiang were alive and racked, would he not have told all?

sentences.zh: 既有成憲可循，即不為已甚，就所供各節，情雖可原，法難寬宥，言念及此，不禁垂淚！

translations.literal: Since established precedent exists, even were I not to go to extremes, yet on the points confessed, though the circumstances might plead for mercy, the law cannot be relaxed. Speaking of this, I cannot keep back my tears!"
translations.idiomatic: Precedent stands; though I might not press every extremity, on what has been admitted the facts may plead for pity but the code cannot bend—at the thought I cannot hold back tears!"

sentences.zh: 」柏葰遂伏法。

translations.literal: " Bo Yi then suffered execution.
translations.idiomatic: Bo Yi was executed.

sentences.zh: 十一年，穆宗即位，肅順等既敗，御史任兆堅疏請昭雪，下禮、刑兩部詳議，議上，詔曰：「柏葰聽受囑託，罪無可辭。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, when Emperor Muzong took the throne and Sushun and the others had fallen, censor Ren Zhaojian memorialized asking that the case be cleared; the Board of Rites and the Ministry of Justice were ordered to deliberate in detail. When their report came up, an edict said: "Bo Yi accepted entreaties—his guilt admits no excuse.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11, after Muzong succeeded and Sushun's party fell, Censor Ren Zhaojian asked that Bo Yi be vindicated; Rites and Justice deliberated and reported. The edict read: "Bo Yi took bribes of influence—his guilt is clear.

sentences.zh: 惟載垣、端華、肅順等因律無僅關囑託明文，比賄買關節之例，擬以斬決。

translations.literal: Only Zaiyuan, Duanhua, and Sushun, because the code had no article dealing solely with entreaties, compared him to the precedent for buying examination favor and proposed decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Zaiyuan, Duanhua, and Sushun, finding no statute that covered influence alone, matched him to the bribery precedent and urged decapitation.

sentences.zh: 由載垣等平日與柏葰挾有私仇，欲因擅作威福，竟以牽連蒙混之詞，致罹重闢。

translations.literal: Because Zaiyuan and the others on ordinary days bore private grudges against Bo Yi and wished to abuse their power, they used language of vague implication and brought him to the heaviest penalty.
translations.idiomatic: They had long nursed private enmity and, abusing their power, smeared him with vague charges until he faced death.

sentences.zh: 皇考聖諭有'不禁垂淚'之語，仰見不為已甚之心。

translations.literal: The late emperor's sacred instruction contained the words 'cannot keep back tears,' showing a mind unwilling to go too far.
translations.idiomatic: His late father's words, 'cannot hold back tears,' show he did not wish to be harsh.

sentences.zh: 今兩宮皇太后政令維新，事事務從寬大平允。

translations.literal: Now the two empress dowagers renew the government and in all things seek breadth, fairness, and balance.
translations.idiomatic: Now the two empress dowagers reform rule and seek fairness in every matter.

sentences.zh: 柏葰不能謂無罪，該御史措詞失當。

translations.literal: Bo Yi cannot be called guiltless, and that censor's wording was improper.
translations.idiomatic: Bo Yi was not innocent, and the censor spoke out of turn.

sentences.zh: 念柏葰受恩兩朝，內廷行走多年，平日勤慎，雖已置重典，當推皇考法外之仁。

translations.literal: Considering that Bo Yi received favor under two reigns, served in the inner court many years, and was ordinarily diligent, though the heavy penalty was already applied, the late emperor's mercy beyond the code should be extended.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he served two reigns, walked the inner court for years, and was usually careful; though the law took his life, his father's grace beyond the code should be remembered.

sentences.zh: 」於是錄其子候選員外郎鍾濂賜四品卿銜，以六部郎中遇缺即選。

translations.literal: " Thereupon his son, candidate vice director Zhong Lian, was granted the rank of fourth-grade courtier and made eligible for immediate selection as a department director when a vacancy arose.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhong Lian, a candidate vice director, was given fourth-rank courtier standing and priority selection as a department director.

sentences.zh: 鍾濂後官盛京兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: Zhong Lian later served as Mukden vice minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Lian later rose to Mukden vice minister of War.

sentences.zh: 麟魁，字梅谷，索綽羅氏，滿洲鑲白旗人。

translations.literal: Lin Kui, style name Meigu, of the Suochiluo clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Kui, courtesy name Meigu, of the Suochiluo clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 道光六年二甲一名進士，選庶吉士，散館改刑部主事，遷中允。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Daoguang he placed second in the jinshi list, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and after leaving the academy was made a principal clerk in Justice and promoted to vice director of the Supervisorate of Instruction.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 6 he ranked second on the jinshi list, entered the Hanlin, left the academy for a Justice clerkship, and became vice director of the Supervisorate.

sentences.zh: 歷庶子、侍講學士、詹事、通政使、左副都御史。

translations.literal: He passed through vice director of instruction, lecturer, junior tutor, grand tutor, and commissioner of the Court of Transmission to left vice censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: He served as vice director, lecturer, junior tutor, grand tutor, transmission commissioner, and left vice censor-in-chief in turn.

sentences.zh: 十七年，出為盛京刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he went out as Mukden vice minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In year 17 he was posted Mukden vice minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 十八年，召授刑部侍郎，兼鑲紅旗漢軍副都統。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was summoned and appointed vice minister of Justice, concurrently vice lieutenant-general of the Bordered Red Banner Chinese Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 he was recalled as vice minister of Justice and vice lieutenant-general of the Bordered Red Banner Chinese Brigade.

sentences.zh: 二十年，署倉場侍郎。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he acted as granary vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20 he acted as granary vice minister.

sentences.zh: 命偕侍郎吳其濬赴湖北按事，劾總督週天爵酷刑，罷之，其濬留署總督。

translations.literal: He was ordered with vice minister Wu Qijun to investigate in Hubei, impeached Governor Zhou Tianjue for cruel punishments and removed him; Qijun remained to act as governor.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered with Vice Minister Wu Qijun to Hubei, he impeached Governor Zhou Tianjue for torture and had him dismissed; Qijun stayed as acting governor.

sentences.zh: 麟魁復往江西鞫鬧漕京控之獄，及江蘇邳州知州賈輝山被劾濫用非刑等事，並治如律。

translations.literal: Lin Kui then went to Jiangxi to try cases of grain-transport riots appealed to the capital, and the matter of Prefect Jia Huishan of Pizhou in Jiangsu impeached for abusive punishments; all were punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: He then tried Jiangxi grain-riot appeals and the case of Pizhou prefect Jia Huishan in Jiangsu for illegal torture; offenders were punished by law.

sentences.zh: 調戶部，又調吏部，充總管內務府大臣。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Revenue, then to Personnel, and appointed superintendent of the Imperial Household.
translations.idiomatic: He moved to Revenue, then Personnel, and became Household superintendent.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，出署山東巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he went out to act as Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: In year 22 he acted as Shandong governor.

sentences.zh: 英兵犯江南，疏陳登州突出黃、渤，三面環海，敵兵船砲堅利，計難與爭，請移兵扼陸路險要。

translations.literal: When British troops invaded Jiangnan he memorialized that Dengzhou juts into the Yellow and Bohai seas with sea on three sides, enemy ships and guns were formidable, and it would be hard to contest them at sea; he asked to shift troops to hold the dangerous land approaches.
translations.idiomatic: As British forces struck Jiangnan he argued Dengzhou thrusts into the Yellow and Bohai with sea on three sides; enemy ships and cannon were too strong at sea, and troops should hold the land passes instead.

sentences.zh: 尋偕侍郎王植赴湖南鞫獄，並勘湖南、江蘇、山東水災，奏請蠲緩，如所請行。

translations.literal: Soon, together with vice minister Wang Zhi, he went to Hunan to try cases and also surveyed floods in Hunan, Jiangsu, and Shandong, memorializing for remission and relief, which was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he and Vice Minister Wang Zhi tried Hunan cases and surveyed floods in Hunan, Jiangsu, and Shandong; relief and tax remission were granted as he asked.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，擢禮部尚書，管理太常寺、鴻​​臚寺。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was promoted to minister of Rites and placed in charge of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Court of Ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: In year 23 he became minister of Rites, overseeing the Sacrifice and Ceremonies courts.

sentences.zh: 河決中牟，命偕尚書廖鴻荃往督工，東西兩​​壩成而屢蟄，褫職，予七品頂戴，仍留工，以料缺水增請緩，复褫頂戴。

translations.literal: When the Yellow River broke at Zhongmou he was ordered with Minister Liao Hongquan to supervise the works; the eastern and western embankments were completed but repeatedly collapsed. He was stripped of office, given seventh-rank hat insignia, and kept at the works; when materials and water were short he again asked for delay and again lost his insignia.
translations.idiomatic: After the Yellow River burst at Zhongmou he and Minister Liao Hongquan supervised repairs; east and west dikes were finished yet kept failing. He lost his post, kept seventh-rank insignia on the job, and when supplies ran short asked delay—then lost the insignia too.

sentences.zh: 召還，予三等侍衛，充葉爾羌參贊大臣，調烏里雅蘇台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Recalled, he was given third-rank bodyguard rank, served as assistant minister at Yarkand, and was transferred to assistant minister at Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled, he received third-rank bodyguard rank, served as Yarkand assistant minister, then Uliastai assistant minister.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，召授禮部侍郎，調刑部。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he was summoned and appointed vice minister of Rites, then transferred to Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In year 27 he was recalled as vice minister of Rites, then Justice.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，复授禮部尚書，兼翰林院掌院學士。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was again appointed minister of Rites and concurrently Hanlin chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In year 28 he again became rites minister and Hanlin chancellor.

sentences.zh: 以前在山東收受陋規，降三級調用，予副都統銜，充烏什辦事大臣。

translations.literal: Because he had earlier accepted improper fees in Shandong, he was demoted three ranks for reassignment, given vice lieutenant-general's insignia, and appointed minister in charge at Ush.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Shandong "customary fees" cost him three ranks, vice lieutenant-general insignia, and a posting as Ush minister in charge.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，疏陳時事，略曰：「廣西逆匪，勞師糜餉。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng he memorialized on current affairs, saying in summary: "The rebel bandits in Guangxi exhaust troops and drain the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 1 he memorialized on affairs of the day: "Guangxi rebels wear out armies and treasury.

sentences.zh: 其始不過星星之火，當時牧令苟安畏事，諱盜不言；

translations.literal: At first they were no more than scattered sparks; then local magistrates, seeking ease and fearing trouble, concealed banditry and would not speak;
translations.idiomatic: They began as scattered sparks; magistrates, clinging to ease and fearing trouble, hid banditry and kept silent;

sentences.zh: 久之蒂固蔓延，養成巨患。

translations.literal: in time the roots grew deep and the blight spread, and a great calamity was nurtured.
translations.idiomatic: until roots ran deep, the plague spread, and a great scourge was bred.

sentences.zh: 請飭封疆大吏嚴查地方，如有教匪、土匪聚眾以及搶劫，隨時查拏，視緝捕之勤惰以為勸懲。

translations.literal: Please order frontier governors and governors-general to search their territories strictly; wherever sect bandits, mountain bandits, or robbers gather, seize them at once, and reward or punish according to zeal in arresting them.
translations.idiomatic: He asked frontier officials to search their ground: wherever sectaries, hill bandits, or robbers gathered, arrest them at once and reward or punish by results.

sentences.zh: 近開捐例，實朝廷萬不得已之舉，各省清查，屢經申令。

translations.literal: The sale of offices recently opened is truly a measure the court takes only when it has no alternative; the provinces have been ordered time and again to audit accounts.
translations.idiomatic: The newly opened sale of offices is a last resort; provinces have been told again and again to audit.

sentences.zh: 宜飭部臣按時詳覈徵解多寡，實行賞罰章程，俾生愧奮。

translations.literal: Ministries should be ordered to verify collections and deliveries on schedule, and actually apply reward-and-punishment rules so that men feel shame and are stirred to effort.
translations.idiomatic: Ministries should verify collections and deliveries on schedule and enforce rewards and penalties so officials feel shame and stir themselves.

sentences.zh: 否則名託清查，事仍敷衍，國儲不裕，官紀益荒，甚非朝廷澄清吏治之意。

translations.literal: Otherwise, though called audits, the work remains perfunctory, the treasury stays strained, and official discipline grows lax—far from the court's intent to clarify governance.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise audits stay nominal, the treasury thin, and discipline lax—far from clarifying rule.

sentences.zh: 」奏入，下所司議行。

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted, the responsible offices were ordered to deliberate and act.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial went in and responsible offices were told to act.

sentences.zh: 授察哈爾副都統，召為戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was appointed vice lieutenant-general of Chahar and summoned as vice minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He became Chahar vice lieutenant-general and was recalled as revenue vice minister.

sentences.zh: 二年，命在軍機大臣上行走，擢工部尚書。

translations.literal: In the second year he was ordered to serve on the Grand Council and promoted to minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 he joined the Grand Council and became works minister.

sentences.zh: 三年，調禮部，充總管內務府大臣，罷直軍機，調刑部。

translations.literal: In the third year he was transferred to Rites, appointed Household superintendent, removed from the Grand Council, and transferred to Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 he moved to Rites, became Household superintendent, left the Council, and shifted to Justice.

sentences.zh: 八年，復調禮部，補內大臣。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was again transferred to Rites and restored as inner court grandee.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 he returned to Rites and regained inner-court grandee status.

sentences.zh: 十年，因謝恩摺失檢，降授刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, because a thanksgiving memorial was lost in transmission, he was demoted to vice minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 a lost thanksgiving memorial cost him the justice vice ministership.

sentences.zh: 是年秋，車駕幸熱河，命署右翼總兵，充巡防大臣。

translations.literal: That autumn, when the imperial procession went to Rehe, he was ordered to act as right-wing commandant and serve as patrol defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, as the court went to Rehe, he acted as right-wing commandant and patrol defense commissioner.

sentences.zh: 英法兵入京師，麟魁部勒僚屬，戒都人守望相助，令家人閉戶厝薪，曰：「事急即燔！

translations.literal: When Anglo-French troops entered the capital, Lin Kui organized his subordinates, warned the people of the capital to watch and help one another, and ordered his household to close doors and stack firewood, saying: "If matters grow urgent, burn it at once!"
translations.idiomatic: When Anglo-French troops entered Beijing, Lin Kui rallied his staff, urged citizens to watch and aid one another, and told his household to bar doors and pile fuel: "Burn everything if it comes to that!"

sentences.zh: 」自宿於巡防廨中，相持數月。

translations.literal: " He himself lodged in the patrol office and held out for several months.
translations.idiomatic: He slept in the patrol office and held on for months.

sentences.zh: 和議成，赴行在，籥請回鑾，為載垣、端華、肅順等所阻。

translations.literal: When peace was made he went to the traveling court and repeatedly begged the emperor to return; Zaiyuan, Duanhua, Sushun, and others blocked him.
translations.idiomatic: After peace he went to the traveling court and pleaded for the emperor's return; Zaiyuan, Duanhua, and Sushun blocked him.

sentences.zh: 十一年，遷左都御史，兼正白旗蒙古都統，尋授兵部尚書。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was transferred to left censor-in-chief, concurrently Mongol lieutenant-general of the Plain White Banner, and soon appointed minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 he became left censor-in-chief and Plain White Mongol lieutenant-general, then war minister.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，協辦大學士。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he was made associate grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 1 he was made associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 時方奉命偕尚書沈兆霖赴甘肅按事，至蘭州，數日遽卒，詔依大學士例賜血卩，賜其子恩壽舉人，諡文端。

translations.literal: At that time he had just been ordered with Minister Shen Zhaolin to investigate in Gansu; he reached Lanzhou and died within days. An edict granted mourning observances according to the grand secretary precedent, gave his son Enshou the juren degree, and posthumously titled him Wenduan.
translations.idiomatic: Just then he and Minister Shen Zhaolin were sent to Gansu; he reached Lanzhou and died within days. Mourning followed grand-secretary precedent, his son Enshou received juren rank, and he was posthumously titled Wenduan.

sentences.zh: 恩壽，同治十三年進士，官至陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Enshou passed the jinshi in the thirteenth year of Tongzhi and rose to governor of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Enshou became a Tongzhi 13 jinshi and rose to Shaanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 瑞常，字芝生，石爾德特氏，蒙古鑲紅旗人，杭州駐防。

translations.literal: Rui Chang, style name Zhisheng, of the Shierdete clan, was a Mongol of the Bordered Red Banner, garrisoned at Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Rui Chang, courtesy name Zhisheng, of the Shierdete clan, was a Bordered Red Mongol garrisoned at Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 道光十二年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Daoguang he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 12 he became jinshi, Hanlin bachelor, and compiler.

sentences.zh: 大考二等，六遷至少詹事。

translations.literal: In the great examination he placed second class and was promoted six times to junior vice director of the Supervisorate of Instruction.
translations.idiomatic: In the palace examination he took second class and rose six steps to junior vice director of the Supervisorate.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，連擢光祿寺卿、內閣學士。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was promoted in succession to director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments and Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In year 24 he rose in quick succession to Court of Entertainments director and Grand Secretariat secretary.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，遷兵部侍郎，兼鑲紅旗漢軍副都統。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he was transferred to vice minister of War and concurrently vice lieutenant-general of the Bordered Red Banner Chinese Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: In year 25 he became war vice minister and Bordered Red Chinese vice lieutenant-general.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，充冊封朝鮮正使。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he served as chief envoy on a mission to invest the Korean king.
translations.idiomatic: In year 29 he headed the Korean investiture mission.

sentences.zh: 調吏部，歷兼左、右翼總兵。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Personnel and successively held the left and right wing commandancies.
translations.idiomatic: He moved to Personnel and held both wing commandancies in turn.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，典江南鄉試，就勘徐州豐北河決，疏陳災情、賑務、漕務，請飭地方官嚴防匪徒蠢擾，報聞。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng he presided over the Jiangnan provincial examination; while surveying the breach of the Fengbei River at Xuzhou he memorialized on disaster conditions, relief, and grain transport, asking local officials to guard strictly against bandits stirring trouble; the report was noted.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 1 he ran the Jiangnan provincial exams; inspecting the Fengbei breach at Xuzhou he reported on disaster, relief, and transport and warned officials to watch for bandits—the court took note.

sentences.zh: 定郡王載銓管步軍統領，越次題升主事，瑞常力爭不得。

translations.literal: Prince of Ding Zaiquan supervised the Metropolitan Infantry Brigade and promoted a principal clerk out of turn; Rui Chang argued strenuously but could not prevail.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Ding Zaiquan oversaw the infantry and promoted a clerk out of turn; Rui Chang fought it in vain.

sentences.zh: 尋解左翼總兵職。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was relieved of the left-wing commandancy.
translations.idiomatic: He soon left the left-wing command.

sentences.zh: 七年，擢左都御史。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was promoted to censor-in-chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 he became left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 八年，遷理籓院尚書，兼正藍旗漢軍都統，署步軍統領，調刑部尚書。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was transferred to minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, concurrently lieutenant-general of the Plain Blue Banner Chinese Brigade, acted as infantry brigade superintendent, and was transferred to minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 he became colonial affairs minister, Plain Blue Chinese lieutenant-general, acting infantry superintendent, then justice minister.

sentences.zh: 十年，寶源局監督張仁政因侵蝕畏罪自盡，命瑞常偕尚書沈兆霖按之，得前任監督奎麟、瑞琇贓私狀，並論大辟，追贓後遣戍。

translations.literal: In the tenth year Zhang Renzheng, supervisor of the Baoyuan Bureau, committed suicide from fear of guilt after embezzlement; Rui Chang was ordered with Minister Shen Zhaolin to investigate and found embezzlement by former supervisors Kui Lin and Rui Xiu; both were sentenced to death, and after recovery of the stolen goods they were banished.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 Baoyuan supervisor Zhang Renzheng killed himself after embezzlement; Rui Chang and Shen Zhaolin found former supervisors Kui Lin and Rui Xiu guilty of graft; both were condemned to death, then banished after restitution.

sentences.zh: 文宗幸熱河，留京辦事，督防巡防。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wenzong went to Rehe, Rui Chang remained in the capital to handle affairs and supervised patrol defense.
translations.idiomatic: When Wenzong went to Rehe, Rui Chang stayed in Beijing to manage affairs and oversee patrol defense.

sentences.zh: 十一年，調工部，又調戶部。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was transferred to Works, then again to Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 he moved to Works, then to Revenue.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，以吏部尚書協辦大學士。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, as minister of Personnel he was made associate grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 1, as personnel minister, he became associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 皇太后命南書房、上書房翰林纂輯史事以昭法戒，書成，賜名治平寶鑑，遴擇大臣輪班進講，瑞常與焉。

translations.literal: The empress dowager ordered Hanlin of the Southern and Upper Studios to compile historical events as warnings in law; when the book was finished it was named Precious Mirror for Ordering the Age, and senior ministers were chosen to lecture in rotation—Rui Chang was among them.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager had Southern and Upper Studio Hanlin compile historical lessons; the finished work was titled Precious Mirror for Ordering the Age, and chosen ministers lectured in turn—Rui Chang among them.

sentences.zh: 四年，充總管內務府大臣。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was appointed superintendent of the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 he became Household superintendent.

sentences.zh: 時陝西巡撫劉蓉驟起膺疆寄，為編修蔡壽祺所劾，蓉自陳辯，疏中引及胡林翼密薦之詞，又倚任布政使林壽圖，為人所忌。

translations.literal: At that time Shaanxi Governor Liu Rong had risen abruptly to frontier command and was impeached by compiler Cai Shouqi; Rong memorialized in his own defense, citing in his memorial Hu Linyi's secret recommendation and relying heavily on provincial treasurer Lin Shoutu—matters that aroused resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi Governor Liu Rong, suddenly elevated to frontier duty, was impeached by Compiler Cai Shouqi; Rong defended himself, citing Hu Linyi's private recommendation and leaning on Treasurer Lin Shoutu—both of which bred resentment.

sentences.zh: 言官遂劾壽圖湎酒廢事，舉劾不公，並訐蓉漏洩之罪，於是命瑞常偕尚書羅惇衍往按之，疏白其無罪，惟坐壽圖演戲及蓉陳奏失當，並予薄譴。

translations.literal: Censors then impeached Shoutu for drinking to excess and neglecting duties, for unfair promotion and demotion, and also charged Rong with leaking secrets; Rui Chang was therefore ordered with Minister Luo Dunyan to investigate. Their memorial cleared them of crime but punished Shoutu for staging plays and Rong for improper memorializing, both with light censure.
translations.idiomatic: Censors charged Shoutu with drunken neglect and unfair personnel acts, and Rong with leaking secrets; Rui Chang and Minister Luo Dunyan were sent to investigate, cleared them of major guilt, but lightly censured Shoutu for theater and Rong for faulty memorials.

sentences.zh: 定陵奉安禮成，題神主，加太子少保。

translations.literal: When the burial rites for Ding Mausoleum were completed, he inscribed the spirit tablet and was given the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: After Ding Mausoleum interment he wrote the spirit tablet and received Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 歷工部、刑部尚書，兼翰林院掌院學士，管理戶部三庫。

translations.literal: He passed through the ministries of Works and Justice as minister, concurrently served as Hanlin chancellor, and managed the three treasuries of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He served as works and justice minister, Hanlin chancellor, and manager of Revenue's three treasuries.

sentences.zh: 六年，赴天津驗收漕糧，復命盤查北新倉，得虧米六萬餘石狀，論所司罪如律。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he went to Tianjin to inspect receipt of tribute grain, and on further orders audited Beixin Granary, finding a shortfall of more than sixty thousand shi of grain; the responsible offices were punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 he inspected tribute grain at Tianjin, then audited Beixin Granary and found over sixty thousand shi missing; offenders were punished by law.

sentences.zh: 十年，拜文淵閣大學士，管理刑部。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion and placed in charge of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 he became Wenyuan grand secretary and oversaw Justice.

sentences.zh: 瑞常歷事三朝，端謹無過，累司文柄，時稱耆碩。

translations.literal: Rui Chang served three reigns, was careful and without fault, repeatedly held literary authority, and was at the time called a senior statesman.
translations.idiomatic: Rui Chang served three reigns, was scrupulous and blameless, often held literary power, and was hailed as an elder statesman.

sentences.zh: 十一年，卒，贈太保，祀賢良祠，諡文端。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he died; he was posthumously given Grand Guardian, enshrined in the Temple of Worthies, and titled Wenduan.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 he died, was posthumously made Grand Guardian, entered the Temple of Worthies, and received the posthumous title Wenduan.

sentences.zh: 子文暉，官至盛京禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: His son Wenhui rose to Mukden vice minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: His son Wenhui became Mukden vice minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 全慶，字小汀，葉赫納喇氏，滿洲正白旗人，尚書那清安子。

translations.literal: Quan Qing, style name Xiaoting, of the Yehe Nara clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner and son of Minister Na Qingan.
translations.idiomatic: Quan Qing, courtesy name Xiaoting, of the Yehe Nara clan, was a Plain White Manchu and son of Minister Na Qingan.

sentences.zh: 道光九年進士，選庶吉士，授編修，累遷侍講。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Daoguang he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, appointed compiler, and promoted in succession to lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 9 he became jinshi and Hanlin bachelor, then compiler and lecturer in turn.

sentences.zh: 大考二等，擢侍讀學士。

translations.literal: In the great examination he placed second class and was promoted to reader of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the palace examination he took second class and became Hanlin reader.

sentences.zh: 歷少詹事、詹事、大理寺卿。

translations.literal: He passed through junior vice director of instruction, grand tutor, and president of the Court of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: He served as junior vice director, grand tutor, and clan court president.

sentences.zh: 以誤班鐫級。

translations.literal: He was demoted one rank for an error in court attendance.
translations.idiomatic: A court-attendance error cost him one rank.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，予頭等侍衛，充古城領隊大臣，調喀喇沙爾辦事大臣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was given first-rank bodyguard rank, served as leading commander at Gucheng, and was transferred to minister in charge at Karashahr.
translations.idiomatic: In year 21 he received first-rank bodyguard rank, led at Gucheng, then became Karashahr minister in charge.

sentences.zh: 召還，未行，會回疆興墾，伊犁將軍布彥泰疏留全慶偕林則徐往勘。

translations.literal: Recalled before he had set out, it happened that reclamation was being promoted in the Western Regions; Ili General Buyantai memorialized to retain Quan Qing to survey with Lin Zexu.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled before departure, Western Regions reclamation began; Ili General Buyantai asked to keep Quan Qing to survey with Lin Zexu.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，至葉爾羌，疏言：「和爾罕地膏腴，哈拉木札什水渠可資灌溉。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he reached Yarkand and memorialized: "The land at Heerhan is fertile; the Khalamuzhash canal can supply irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: In year 25 at Yarkand he reported: "Heerhan soil is rich; the Khalamuzhash canal can irrigate it.

sentences.zh: 又巴爾楚克為回疆扼要之地，道光十二年已奏開墾屯田，未種者尚多，應先侭安插民戶，俾成重鎮。

translations.literal: Moreover, Barkul is a strategic point in the Western Regions; in the twelfth year of Daoguang reclamation and military colonies were already approved, yet much land remains unplanted—civilian households should be settled first so it may become a strong garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Barkul is a strategic pass; Daoguang 12 already approved colonies, yet much land lies idle—settlers should come first to make it a stronghold.

sentences.zh: 」詔如所請行。

translations.literal: " An edict approved as requested.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved.

sentences.zh: 先是，全慶疏陳喀喇沙爾環城荒地，及庫爾勒、北山根，可墾田萬餘畝，命辦事大臣常清籌辦。

translations.literal: Earlier, Quan Qing had memorialized that the wasteland around Karashahr and at Korla and the northern foothills could yield more than ten thousand mu of fields, and the minister in charge Chang Qing was ordered to plan it.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier he had reported Karashahr's outskirts, Korla, and the northern foothills could yield ten thousand-plus mu; Minister Chang Qing was told to plan it.

sentences.zh: 至是復偕則徐詳勘，疏言：「庫爾勒應於此大渠南岸接開中渠，引入新墾之地，分開支渠二。

translations.literal: At this time he again surveyed in detail with Lin Zexu and memorialized: "At Korla a middle canal should be opened south of this main canal to bring water into newly reclaimed land, with two branch canals.
translations.idiomatic: He surveyed again with Lin Zexu: "At Korla open a middle canal south of the main trunk into new land, with two branches.

sentences.zh: 其北山根展寬開都河龍口，別開大渠，與舊渠並行；

translations.literal: At the northern foothills the mouth of the Kaidu River should be widened and a new main canal opened to run parallel with the old canal;
translations.idiomatic: At the northern hills widen the Kaidu mouth and open a new main canal parallel to the old;

sentences.zh: 再分支渠四，別開退水渠一。

translations.literal: then four more branch canals and one drainage canal.
translations.idiomatic: then four branches and one drainage canal.

sentences.zh: 」又疏言：「伊拉里克在吐魯番托克遜軍台西，地平土潤，土人謂之'板土戈壁'。

translations.literal: " He also memorialized: "Ilarik lies west of the Toksun courier station on the Turfan route; the ground is level and the soil moist—the locals call it the 'plate-soil gobi.'"
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote: "Ilarik lies west of Toksun on the Turfan route—level, moist ground locals call 'plate-soil gobi.'"

sentences.zh: 其西為'沙石戈壁'，有大小阿拉渾兩水，彙為一河。

translations.literal: " West of it is the 'gravel gobi,' where the great and small Alahun streams join into one river.
translations.idiomatic: West lies 'gravel gobi,' where great and small Alahun streams unite.

sentences.zh: 此次引水自西而東，鑿成大渠，復多開支渠以資灌溉。

translations.literal: This time water is to be led from west to east, a great canal cut, and many branch canals opened for irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: Water will run west to east through a main canal and many branches for irrigation.

sentences.zh: 伊拉里克西南沿山為蒙古出入之路，墾地在滿卡南附近，東西兩面，以'人壽年豐'四字分號，各設正副戶長一，鄉約四，擇誠實農民充之，承領耕種。

translations.literal: Southwest of Ilarik along the mountains is the Mongol pass; reclaimed land lies near Manka south, divided east and west under the four characters 'long life, rich harvest,' each side with one chief and deputy household head and four village elders chosen from honest farmers to receive land and farm.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest of Ilarik is the Mongol route; colonies near Manka split east and west under the motto 'long life, rich harvest,' each with chief and deputy heads and four elders—honest farmers who receive plots.

sentences.zh: 又吐魯番為南北樞紐，應安置內地民戶，戶領地五十畝，農田以水利為首務。

translations.literal: Turfan is also the pivot between north and south; inland households should be settled, fifty mu per household, and for farmland water control comes first.
translations.idiomatic: Turfan is the north-south hinge; inland settlers should get fifty mu each—water comes first in farming.

sentences.zh: 此次開渠，自龍口至黑山頭，地勢高低，碎石夾沙，渠身易淤，酌定經久修治章程。

translations.literal: For this canal work from the river mouth to Heishantou the terrain rises and falls, gravel mixes with sand, and the channel silts easily—lasting repair rules were drafted.
translations.idiomatic: From river mouth to Heishantou the slope varies, gravel and sand clog the bed—lasting repair rules were set.

sentences.zh: 」並如所請行。

translations.literal: " All were approved as requested.
translations.idiomatic: All was approved.

sentences.zh: 自是回疆南路凡墾田六十餘萬畝。

translations.literal: From this time the southern route of the Western Regions had in all more than six hundred thousand mu under cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the southern route had over six hundred thousand mu under cultivation.

sentences.zh: 回京，擢內閣學士，兼正紅旗漢軍副都統。

translations.literal: Returning to the capital, he was promoted to Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat and concurrently vice lieutenant-general of the Plain Red Banner Chinese Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: Back in the capital he became Grand Secretariat secretary and Plain Red Chinese vice lieutenant-general.

sentences.zh: 歷刑部、吏部、戶部、倉場侍郎。

translations.literal: He passed through vice ministries of Justice, Personnel, Revenue, and the granary.
translations.idiomatic: He served as justice, personnel, revenue, and granary vice minister.

sentences.zh: 咸豐四年，擢工部尚書，兼正紅旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xianfeng he was promoted to minister of Works and concurrently lieutenant-general of the Plain Red Banner Chinese Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 4 he became works minister and Plain Red Chinese lieutenant-general.

sentences.zh: 七年，調兵部。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to War.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 he moved to War.

sentences.zh: 九年，命赴天津驗收漕糧。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was ordered to Tianjin to inspect receipt of tribute grain.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 he was sent to Tianjin to inspect tribute grain.

sentences.zh: 時英兵犯大沽，僧格林沁擊卻之。

translations.literal: At that time British troops attacked Dagu and were repelled by Sengge Rinchen.
translations.idiomatic: British forces struck Dagu and Sengge Rinchen drove them back.

sentences.zh: 全慶疏陳兵事，略謂：「敵軍戰敗之後，不進不退，心實叵測。

translations.literal: Quan Qing memorialized on military affairs, saying in summary: "After defeat the enemy army neither advances nor retreats—its intentions are truly hard to fathom.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized on war: "After defeat the enemy neither advances nor retreats—its intent is hard to read.

sentences.zh: 竊恐別有舉動，未必從此就撫而去。

translations.literal: I fear they may have other moves and may not from this accept pacification and depart.
translations.idiomatic: They may not simply accept terms and leave.

sentences.zh: 我之精銳，盡萃大沽，旁無應援，後無擁護。

translations.literal: Our crack troops are all gathered at Dagu with no support on the flanks and no backing behind.
translations.idiomatic: Our best troops cluster at Dagu without flank support or rear reserve.

sentences.zh: 雙港之旅，已調前敵；

translations.literal: The force at Shuanggang has already been shifted to the front;
translations.idiomatic: Shuanggang's troops are already at the front;

sentences.zh: 津門之備，但資土練；

translations.literal: Tianjin's defense relies only on local militia;
translations.idiomatic: Tianjin relies on local militia alone;

sentences.zh: 北塘一帶，又頗空虛。

translations.literal: and the Beitang sector is again quite empty.
translations.idiomatic: Beitang is largely undefended.

sentences.zh: 應請速簡重臣，發勁旅，嚴近畿海口之備，為僧格林沁之援，令廣東義勇搗香港以牽其援兵，登州水師合旅順以截其歸路，然後國威可振，撫局可成。

translations.literal: A senior minister should be chosen at once, crack troops dispatched, and defenses at the capital's sea mouths strengthened to aid Sengge Rinchen; Guangdong volunteers should strike Hong Kong to tie down reinforcements, and Dengzhou naval forces join Lüshun to cut the enemy's line of retreat—then national prestige can be restored and negotiations succeed.
translations.idiomatic: He asked for a senior commander, fresh troops, strengthened sea defenses to aid Sengge Rinchen, Guangdong militia to raid Hong Kong, and Dengzhou ships with Lüshun to cut retreat—then prestige and peace could follow.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，被嘉納。

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted it was praised and accepted.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial won praise.

sentences.zh: 調吏部尚書。

translations.literal: He was transferred to minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He became personnel minister.

sentences.zh: 十年，授內大臣，兼翰林院掌院學士。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was appointed inner court grandee and concurrently Hanlin chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 he became inner-court grandee and Hanlin chancellor.

sentences.zh: 十一年，充總管內務府大臣。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was appointed superintendent of the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 he became Household superintendent.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，追論大學士柏葰科場之獄原讞未允，全慶坐附和定讞，鐫四級，降授大理寺卿。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, when the original verdict in Grand Secretary Bo Yi's examination case was reviewed and found unsatisfactory, Quan Qing was punished for concurring in the sentence, stripped of four ranks, and demoted to president of the Court of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 1, review of Bo Yi's examination verdict punished Quan Qing for concurring—four ranks lost, demoted to clan court president.

sentences.zh: 歷內閣學士、工部侍郎、左都御史。

translations.literal: He passed through Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat, vice minister of Works, and censor-in-chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Grand Secretariat secretary, works vice minister, and left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 五年，授禮部尚書，調刑部。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed minister of Rites and transferred to Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 he became rites minister, then justice minister.

sentences.zh: 十一年，協辦大學士，兼翰林院掌院學士。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was made associate grand secretary and concurrently Hanlin chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 he became associate grand secretary and Hanlin chancellor.

sentences.zh: 十二年，典順天鄉試，以中式舉人徐景春試卷疵謬，鐫二級去職。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he presided over the Shuntian provincial examination; because the papers of successful candidate Xu Jingchun were faulty he was stripped of two ranks and removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 he ran the Shuntian exams; faulty papers by graduate Xu Jingchun cost him two ranks and his post.

sentences.zh: 全慶易攵歷清要，累掌文衡，更閱四朝，雖屢黜，尋即錄用。

translations.literal: Quan Qing had passed through important central posts, repeatedly held literary authority, and spanned four reigns; though often demoted, he was soon employed again.
translations.idiomatic: Quan Qing had held key central posts, often ran examinations, and spanned four reigns—demoted often, yet soon re-employed.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，授內閣學士。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 1 he became Grand Secretariat secretary.

sentences.zh: 复歷禮部侍郎、左都御史、刑部尚書、協辦大學士。

translations.literal: He again passed through vice minister of Rites, censor-in-chief of the Left, minister of Justice, and associate grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He again served as rites vice minister, left censor-in-chief, justice minister, and associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 五年，鄉舉重逢，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, meeting the provincial examination again after long service, he was given Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5, encountering the provincial exam again in senior service, he received Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 六年，拜體仁閣大學士。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Tiren Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 he became Tiren Pavilion grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 七年，致仕，食全俸。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he retired and received full salary.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 he retired on full pay.

sentences.zh: 八年，卒，晉贈太子太保，祀賢良祠，諡文恪。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he died; he was advanced posthumously to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, enshrined in the Temple of Worthies, and titled Wenkai.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 he died, was raised posthumously to Grand Guardian, entered the Temple of Worthies, and was titled Wenkai.

sentences.zh: 論曰：自道光以來，科場請託，習為故常，寒門才士，為之抑遏。

translations.literal: The commentary says: Since Daoguang, entreaties in the examination halls have become habitual, and talented men of humble families have been held back.
translations.idiomatic: The appraisal says: Since Daoguang, examination favoritism became habit and poor scholars were shut out.

sentences.zh: 柏葰立朝正直，且所不免，其罹大辟也，出於肅順等之構陷。

translations.literal: Bo Yi was upright in court and could not escape it himself; that he suffered capital punishment came from framing by Sushun and others.
translations.idiomatic: Bo Yi stood upright yet could not escape; his death came from Sushun's faction framing him.

sentences.zh: 然自此司文衡者懍懍畏法，科場清肅，曆三十年，至光緒中始漸弛，弊竇复滋，終未至如前此之甚者，實文宗用重典之效，足以挽回風氣也。

translations.literal: Yet from this time those who controlled the examinations feared the law; the halls were kept clean for thirty years, and only in Guangxu did discipline gradually relax and abuses reappear—yet never as severe as before—truly the effect of Emperor Wenzong's heavy precedent, enough to turn the wind of custom.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward examiners feared the law; halls stayed clean thirty years until Guangxu slackened—yet never as bad as before—Wenzong's stern example had turned custom.

sentences.zh: 麟魁、瑞常、全慶皆起家文學，洊陟綸扉，其建白猶有可紀焉。

translations.literal: Lin Kui, Rui Chang, and Quan Qing all rose from literary beginnings and ascended to the grand secretariat; their memorialized counsel still merits record.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Kui, Rui Chang, and Quan Qing all rose through letters to the grand secretariat; their counsel is still worth noting.
